def build(ctx):
    a = ctx.alloc(3)
    b = ctx.alloc(3)
    ctx.reg("a", a)
    ctx.reg("b", b)
    
    # Cuccaro adder for n=3
    # carry[0] is implicit 0, we use ancillas for carry[1..3]
    c1 = ctx.alloc(1)
    c2 = ctx.alloc(1)
    c3 = ctx.alloc(1)
    
    # Bit 0: compute carry1 = majority(a0, b0, 0) = a0 & b0
    ctx.ccx(a[0], b[0], c1[0])
    ctx.cx(a[0], b[0])
    ctx.cx(b[0], c1[0])
    # Now c1 = a0&b0 ^ a0 ^ b0 (not majority yet, but we'll fix later)
    
    # Bit 1: compute carry2 = majority(a1, b1, c1)
    ctx.ccx(a[1], b[1], c2[0])
    ctx.cx(a[1], b[1])
    ctx.cx(b[1], c2[0])
    # Now c2 = a1&b1 ^ a1 ^ b1
    # Combine with c1: need to add c1 to c2
    ctx.ccx(a[1], c1[0], c2[0])
    ctx.cx(a[1], c1[0])
    ctx.cx(c1[0], c2[0])
    # Now c2 = majority(a1, b1, c1)
    
    # Bit 2: compute carry3 = majority(a2, b2, c2)
    ctx.ccx(a[2], b[2], c3[0])
    ctx.cx(a[2], b[2])
    ctx.cx(b[2], c3[0])
    ctx.ccx(a[2], c2[0], c3[0])
    ctx.cx(a[2], c2[0])
    ctx.cx(c2[0], c3[0])
    # Now c3 = majority(a2, b2, c2)
    
    # Compute sum bits: s[i] = a[i] ^ b[i] ^ carry[i]
    # carry[0] = 0, so s0 = a0 ^ b0
    ctx.cx(a[0], b[0])  # b0 = a0 ^ b0 (this is s0)
    # s1 = a1 ^ b1 ^ c1
